verdict.rationale: Slate is a terminal coding agent with natural-language interaction, shell execution (`!`), file references (`@filename`), and claims of running integration tests manually, all of which support NL-driven troubleshooting, but no docs or examples explicitly show a debugging workflow (e.g., 'find why this test fails') or independent verification of debugging success. Missing for 10: explicit debugging-specific example/transcript, independent hands-on confirmation that NL debugging actually resolves issues.
